why: The 19 development sentences of tools/measure_route.py CASES have now been used to decide a switch: the route completion pass ships off because that corpus measured it at a precision of 0.20. That is a legitimate use of a development corpus and it spends it. From this point on, a number measured on those same 19 sentences cannot be reported as untouched validation, however many repeats it carries, because the code has been changed in response to what they said.
rule: Held apart. Nothing in this file may be used to tune, select, fix or choose anything -- no switch, no threshold, no prompt, no expectation -- and no run against it may be used to decide whether a change ships. It is measured ONCE, after a change has already been decided elsewhere, to say how far the router generalises beyond the sentences it was developed on. A run that reports it must publish this file's sha256 and the commit that last touched it; a second measurement of it, after anything was tuned in response to the first, is a development number and must be reported as one.
not_measured: No run of this set exists on 2026-09-28. The route measurements of that day, with the completion pass on and off, are over the 19 development prompts only, and they are what CB05 corrects the reading of.
protocol_when_it_is_measured: Identical to tools/measure_route.py: each prompt routed N times through POST /api/chats/{id}/tasks/propose, which builds an envelope and runs nothing, scored CORRECT only when the proposal validates AND its area, the set of its question types and every governed value the sentence names are the expected ones. `provider` and `fragment` pick the shipped example whose data is attached, exactly as the development corpus does. Expectations here come from the engines' declared vocabularies and from the area each paraphrase belongs to -- never from a model's answer.
reading: 19 unseen paraphrases, one per development sentence, in the language of the sentence they paraphrase or deliberately in the other one. They are paraphrases and not new tasks: the same five areas, the same declared vocabularies, the same shipped examples. What they are not is the sentences the router's behaviour was developed against.

paraphrases.prompt: What economy does this article talk about?
paraphrases.paraphrase_of: Which economy is named in this news?

paraphrases.prompt: ¿Sobre qué economía trata esta nota de prensa?
dime de que economia trata y con que animo esta escrita
paraphrases.paraphrase_of: de que economia habla y con que tono
paraphrases.why: two `choice` questions, as the envelope tools/verify_envelopes.py runs for the sentence it paraphrases
